learning_outcomes.text: Demonstrate the capacity for analysis and synthesis.
Acquire the capacity for effective problem-solving.
Express oneself correctly in Spanish, both orally and in writing.
Acquire skills related to the use of computer programs for calculation, data analysis, and processing within its field of application.
Information search and management skill.
Possess the capacity for decision-making.
Develop critical reasoning.
Develop the capacity for teamwork.
Capacity to apply knowledge to practice.
Capacity to generate new ideas (creativity).
Ability to work autonomously.
Motivation for quality and continuous improvement.
Become aware of issues related to the environment.
Knowledge and capacities for organizing and managing projects.

Capacity for writing and developing projects in the field of industrial and automatic electronic engineering, for the construction, renovation, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly or operation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical installations, industrial installations and plants, and manufacturing processes.
Capacity for directing the activities subject to the engineering projects described in the previous section.
Capacity to perform measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert opinions, studies, reports, work plans and other similar tasks.
Facility for handling specifications, regulations and mandatory standards.
Capacity for interpreting projects and technical reports.
Capacity to develop and implement occupational safety and risk prevention measures.

syllabus_topics: BASIC CONCEPTS OF TECHNICAL PROJECTS AND THEIR CLASSIFICATION.
1st PRACTICAL CASES. EXECUTION AND STUDY OF INDUSTRIAL TECHNICAL PROJECT (TO BE SPECIFIED DURING THE COURSE).
2nd PRACTICAL CASES. EXECUTION AND STUDY OF INDUSTRIAL TECHNICAL PROJECT (TO BE SPECIFIED DURING THE COURSE).
Concepts of industrial lighting, electrical installations, heat generators, automation, manufacturing processes, cogeneration.
KNOWLEDGE TAUGHT ONLY IN THEORETICAL CLASSES.
QUALITY MANAGEMENT TOOLS. FAILURE MODE AND EFFECT ANALYSIS. QUALITY FUNCTION DEPLOYMENT. SWOT ANALYSIS. BENCHMARKING. LEAN MANUFACTURING.
teaching_methods: Public presentation of works, debates, visits to company facilities, tutorials
Execution of Technical Projects, Works, Reports, Memoirs and Evaluation Tests

assessment_methods.method: Exam type test of theoretical and practical knowledge
Technical Projects carried out in practical classes in small work groups

assessment_rules: For both the first and second calls, the evaluation consists of a theoretical and practical knowledge exam (38%), a practical exercises exam (30%), and technical projects (32%). A minimum grade of 3 out of 10 points is required for each component. For the second call, grades from the first call are not maintained for the exams. However, the grade for technical projects is maintained, or new work will be assigned if not previously submitted.
